entries: Are they not many? Ill has befallen Solmaria, Armindas can see.
他们难道不多吗？灾难已降临索尔玛利亚，阿尔明达斯看得见。
Fae have this concept, but different. It is not for you to know.
妖精也有这样的观念，但不一样。这不是你该知道的。
#. It is good to see. Many long years in this place. # has learned to break servitude. This is good. Too young to remember this place.
#。见到你真好。困居此地，已历许多漫长岁月。# 已学会挣脱奴役。这很好。你太年幼，不记得这地方。
Near this gate. Armindas has seen this village. Remind of home. This is home now.
就在这门旁。阿尔明达斯见过那座村庄。令人想起故乡。现在，这里就是家。
We have little use for books. Our memories are steadfast and enduring. We share knowledge openly, something which humans could learn from.
我们不大用得上书。我们的记忆恒久不灭，知识坦诚共享——人类大可以此为师。
Armindas welcomes you. What service can there be?
阿尔明达斯欢迎你。可有什么需要效劳？
Ore, rock. These are more than they appear. Connected to the world. Corundum is part of Solmaria.
矿石，岩石。它们不止表面所示。与世界相连。刚玉，是索尔玛利亚的一部分。
Now Armindas must rest. This was last gift to Solmaria. Peace awaits.
如今阿尔明达斯须得歇息了。这是给索尔玛利亚的最后礼物。安宁在等待。
Origins unknown. Part of Solmaria, or like fae? Would like to know, but fate is decided. Shall remain here.
起源不明。是索尔玛利亚的一部分，还是像妖精？想知道，但命运已定。就留在这里。
Unprecedented? This companionship is strange. Armindas unsure.
前所未有？这份同行之情，很陌生。阿尔明达斯不确定。
Foul. Armindas does not like. However... history with them can cloud thoughts. Are they all as Armindas sees them? Hope to be wrong.
恶臭之辈。阿尔明达斯不喜欢。不过……与他们的旧事会蒙蔽判断。他们都如阿尔明达斯所见的那般吗？但愿看走了眼。
Welcome. Armindas does not get visitors. It is a pleasure.
欢迎。阿尔明达斯少有访客。幸甚。
You have a gleam in your eye. See beauty, do you not?
你眼中有光。你看见了美，是么？
We guide, for we were once guided. A debt paid by service. But.. not our nature, as some think.
我们指引，因为我们曾被指引。以效力偿还恩情。但……这并非我们的天性，不像某些人所想。
This might speak to the fog that these experience. Perhaps these see a fog where these are unable... or not permitted to see.
这或许正应了诸位所经历的迷雾。也许在诸位无法……或不被允许看见之处，所见便是迷雾。
Armindas was once a leader. Very old now. Wish for final cycles to be on Miala. Other gates are lost. Have only this.
阿尔明达斯曾是首领。如今很老了。愿最后的轮次在米亚拉上度过。别的门都已失落。只剩这一道。
Human. Greetings. Welcome to Armindas' solitude.
人类。致意。欢迎来到阿尔明达斯的独居之地。
Ancient among humans. Yes, older than you appear. Like Armindas.
在人类中算古老。是的，比看上去更老。和阿尔明达斯一样。
It is a key to knowledge. To places, of mind and body. Forbidden for Armindas to read. This is to protect.
它是通往知识的钥匙。通往心智与实体的诸多所在。阿尔明达斯被禁止阅读它。这是保护。
Such things were not meant for fae. Fae have our own things not meant for humans.
这等事物本非为妖精而设。妖精也有不属于人类的事物。
这种东西，米亚拉，并没有。
Even here, beneath. Preserve the past in stone.
即便在此，在下。以石封存往昔。
Powerful. Dangerous. Beautiful. Describes many things, yes? Armindas will keep his secrets.
强大。危险。美丽。能形容许多东西，是吧？阿尔明达斯会守住他的秘密。
Fae know him well, for he is of Miala. Free of him now, those that remain. We cannot return to them. This is a great sadness. That is why Armindas is here.
妖精们深知他，因为他出自米亚拉。如今尚存的同族，已得自由。我们无法回到他们身边。这是极大的悲哀。正因如此，阿尔明达斯才在这里。
An animal. This one understands the concept. Such a place as this contains animals. Such things are dangerous, but just. All must eventually be consumed.
一种动物。此身明白其含义。这样的地方自有动物栖居。此等生灵危险，却公正。万物终将彼此吞噬。
Home of Kalindras? Armindas' translation is adequate. Perhaps insufficient. This word is older than Armindas.
卡林德拉斯之家园？阿尔明达斯的转译尚算恰当。或许还不够。这个词比阿尔明达斯更古老。
Speak the same language in many ways. Sing to me, if it pleases you.
在许多方面，我们说的是同一种语言。若你愿意，唱给我听吧。
Not friends. Wicked to fae, in times past. Goblins worse.
不是朋友。往昔对妖精作恶。哥布林，更甚。
Perhaps, Joid. An old friend. Or older. Zakerunda. Armindas did not know him.
也许吧，乔伊德。一位故友。或更久远。扎克伦达。阿尔明达斯并不认识他。
Many places. There are so many places. Cannot visit the one most desired.
许多地方。有那么多地方。唯独最想去的那一处，去不了。
Greetings warrior. You do well to keep company with these friends. Sense loyalty.
致意，战士。与这些朋友为伴，你做得很好。感知到了忠诚。
You are on it. A piece . Drifting. If life sustains here, perhaps... Much that Solmaria gained was at cost to Miala. And much that Solmaria suffered was freedom for Miala.
你正踩在它上面。一块碎片。漂游着。若这里尚能维系生命，也许……索尔玛利亚所得之物，多是以米亚拉为代价；而索尔玛利亚所受之苦，多是米亚拉换来的自由。
Just as this is a shard of Miala, it was right to keep this relic here. Here, take it.
既然这是米亚拉的一块碎片，把这件遗物留在这里便是应当的。来，拿着。
